sloka: स तु प्रहाराभिहतः सुग्रीवेण महागजः।अपासर्पद्धनुर्मात्रं निषसाद ननाद च ।। ६.९७.१९ ।।
transliteration: sa tu prahārābhihataḥ sugrīveṇa mahāgajaḥ।apāsarpaddhanurmātraṁ niṣasāda nanāda ca ।। 6.97.19 ।।

translations.english: Overwhelmed by the blow of Sugriva, that great elephant retreated four cubits, distressed, and roared.
